correctness.rationale: The local Moore-neighbor count is |a|+|b|+|c|-b_r. Each fixed configuration corresponds bijectively to a length-n closed walk in an explicitly enumerated 64-vertex graph. An exact independent-integer transfer checker verifies the two 30- and 27-state recurrent components, all characteristic coefficients, the common period-three weight family, and rational Perron bounds; a separately implemented direct C++ evolution checker exhaustively verifies n=3..7. The exact finite graph computation, not bounded enumeration, proves the universal formulas. Positivity, irreducibility and the common loop imply the asymptotics.

value.rationale: The precise whole-family stationary-state invariant for two canonical neighboring Life-like automata reveals a non-obvious arithmetic resonance: one deleted stable transfer transition forces exponentially different relative populations for two circumference classes while allowing almost identical populations for multiples of three. The complete spectral formulas and explicit common-column phase explain the difference. This is more than a small-size census or the known inclusion of still lifes, and it is potentially useful in distinguishing symbolic dynamical constraints on narrow periodic media.
